result.summary: The environment features a wide main road with no marked pedestrian crossings, forcing pedestrians to cross unprotected. While sidewalks and side-street crosswalks are present, the lack of infrastructure on the primary thoroughfare and visual obstructions from parked cars increase risk.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing on main road
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the two-lane main road without the protection of a marked crosswalk or signal.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, across the main asphalt roadway.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb block sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility (continental) crosswalk across the main road to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with embedded trolley tracks and sidewalks on both sides. While a marked crosswalk exists for the side street, the main thoroughfare lacks designated pedestrian crossings, and parked vehicles may obstruct sightlines at intersections.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway can be a tripping hazard for pedestrians and a slipping hazard for cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center left, running parallel to the road

hazards.name: Lack of Main Road Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalk or pedestrian infrastructure across the wide main thoroughfare.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground across the main road

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corner may block the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the main road near the side street intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks across the main thoroughfare to designate pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to clear sightlines.

result.summary: The image shows a mixed-use urban street with continuous sidewalks but a complete lack of formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the visible intersection. Parked vehicles along the curb create sightline obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross the wide, unmarked roadway.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There is no marked crosswalk at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross an unprotected, wide roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb near the corner block the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corner to shorten crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps for accessibility at the crossing points.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban thoroughfare with a central concrete median that appears to serve as a transit platform. While sidewalks are present on both sides, there are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals visible, creating a high-exposure environment for anyone attempting to cross the multi-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks across this wide multi-lane road, forcing pedestrians to cross unprotected.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The overall width of the roadway creates a long exposure time for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Continuous rows of parked cars along the curbs can block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Formalize the central median as a pedestrian refuge with proper signage and ADA-compliant ramps.
